mistake_reason: At step 22, DataVerification_Expert exhibits loss of conversation history (FM-1.4). Despite earlier verifying the full 10-member ASEAN list and computing that Jakarta–Naypyidaw (Indonesia–Myanmar) is the farthest, the agent resets and treats the prompt as new. They recompile ASEAN members but omit Indonesia entirely, discarding previously gathered data and constraints. This context amnesia causes distances to be computed on an incomplete subset, yielding 'Naypyidaw–Manila' as the maximum. GeographicalData_Expert then outputs 'Myanmar, Philippines', which is incorrect. The failure stems directly from disregarding the earlier confirmed dataset and results due to unexpected context truncation.
